name: Marching Cubes Tetrahedron Decomposition
definition: A variant that applies the Marching Tetrahedrons algorithm to a cube by decomposing the cube into 6 tetrahedrons, aiming to resolve topological ambiguities inherent in standard Marching Cubes.
summary: Marching Cubes Tetrahedron Decomposition resolves standard Marching Cubes topological ambiguities by decomposing voxels into tetrahedra and using a 16-case lookup table for edge interpolation.
